login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Anyone can browse the chapter's public photos and videos. Signing in is for the core team, by invitation from a chapter admin.
login.invalidEmail: Enter a full email address, like name@qu.edu.qa.
login.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
login.rateLimited: Too many requests from this address. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.sent: If {email} has access, we sent a 6-digit code. It works for 10 minutes.
login.codeHint: Paste or type the code. We'll sign you in on the sixth digit.
login.wrongCode: That code isn't right. {left, plural, one {# attempt left} other {# attempts left}}.
login.expired: This code has expired. Send a new one to continue.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Request a new code to continue.
login.redirecting: Taking you to where you were going.
login.requestIntro: Tell us who you are. A chapter admin reviews every request.
login.requestRequired: Add your name and choose a gender.
login.requestReview: An admin will review your request. If it's approved, you'll get an email with a link to sign in.

states.sessionBody: For your security you were signed out. Sign in again and we'll bring you back to {place}.
states.sessionBodyPlain: For your security you were signed out. Sign in again to continue.
states.notFoundBody: The link may be wrong, or this photo or video isn't available to your account.
states.offline: You're offline. What's already loaded still works; downloads and uploads wait until you're back.
states.errorTitle: Something went wrong on our side
states.errorBody: Your photos and videos are safe. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell a chapter admin.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.nameHelp: Shown on photos and videos you upload.
account.emailHelp: You sign in with codes sent here. Ask an admin to change it.
account.coreHelp: Can view core content and upload.
account.adminHelp: Can view core content, upload, and manage members, events and processing.
account.signOutAllHelp: Signing out of all devices ends every session, including phones. You'll need a new code on each.

library.title: Library
library.noResultsBody: Search looks at event titles and descriptions. Try a shorter word or check the spelling.
library.emptyCoreBody: Create the first event and upload its photos and videos. Public items show as soon as they're ready.
library.emptyMemberBody: Photos and videos appear here after the chapter's events.
library.errorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Your photos are safe. Try again in a moment.

errors.bad_request: Something in that request wasn't right.
errors.csrf: Your browser blocked that request. Reload and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.expired_code: This code has expired. Send a new one to continue.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code to continue.
errors.conflict: That changed while you were looking. Reload and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.profile_incomplete: Add your name and gender to your profile first.

event.countLine: {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} · {videos, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}
event.emptyCoreBody: Add the event's media. Photos are ready in seconds; videos take longer.
event.emptyMemberBody: This event's photos and videos will appear here once they're ready.
event.tierHelpEdit: Items already in the event keep their own setting.
event.deleteBody: All of its photos and videos are deleted too. This can't be undone.

tile.failed: Upload failed, open My uploads to retry

upload.title: Upload
upload.descriptionHint: One or two sentences everyone will see
upload.defaultTier: Who can see new uploads by default
upload.tierHelp: You can change this for each file in the next step.
upload.pickEvent: Choose an event or create a new one.
upload.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
upload.accepted: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, AVIF, WebP, MP4, MOV · large videos are fine
upload.fileSummary: {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} · {videos, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} · {size}
upload.girlsOnlyHelp: Only female core members and admins can see these
upload.tip: Turn off HDR video on chapter phones before an event. Those videos process about twice as fast and look the same on every screen.
upload.tipPath: iPhone: Settings › Camera › Record Video › HDR Video
upload.uploadedAll: Uploaded {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
upload.progressMeta: {sent} of {total}{left, select, none {} waiting { · waiting to start} stalled { · stalled, nothing sent for 20 s} other { · about {left} left}}
upload.leaveHint: You can leave this page. If uploads stop, pick the same files again and they continue where they left off.
upload.moreWaiting: {n, plural, one {# more file waiting} other {# more files waiting}}
upload.err_network: The connection dropped {drops, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}. Retry continues from {pct}%.
upload.err_unsupported_type: This isn't a photo or video type we accept.
upload.err_too_large: This file is larger than the 20 GB limit.
upload.err_not_found: The event was deleted or isn't available any more.
upload.err_server: Something went wrong on our side. Retry continues where it stopped.
upload.doneTitle: Uploaded {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
upload.doneWaiting: They're safe on the server and wait for the processor, which isn't running right now. Each item shows up once it's ready.
upload.donePhotosOnly: Photos will be ready in a few seconds. Each item shows up once it's ready.
upload.doneWithVideos: Photos will be ready in a few seconds. Videos take about {duration}, so they should be ready around {time}. Each item shows up once it's ready.
upload.etaHelp: Estimate is based on video length and the current queue. HDR videos take about twice as long.
upload.offline: You're offline. Uploads are paused and will resume on their own when you're back.
upload.resumeBanner: {n, plural, one {Resume # unfinished upload} other {Resume # unfinished uploads}} to {event}. Choose the same files and they continue where they stopped.

myUploads.emptyBody: Photos and videos you upload appear here with their processing status.

uploadErrors.decode_failed: The file looks incomplete. Upload it again from the original device, then retry.
uploadErrors.unsupported_codec: This video uses a format we can't convert. An admin can keep the original only.
uploadErrors.timeout: Processing took too long. Retry, or ask an admin to check it.
uploadErrors.log_profile: Recorded in a Log color profile, so it needs an admin to check before processing.
uploadErrors.unknown_transfer: The video's color format isn't recognised, so it needs an admin to check before processing.
uploadErrors.hdr_still: This is an HDR still image, so it needs an admin to check before processing.
uploadErrors.generic: Processing failed. Retry, or ask an admin to check it.

viewer.failedBody: Check your connection and try again. You can still download the original.
viewer.notReady: This item is still being processed.
viewer.originalOnly: Only the original file is available for this item.

player.position: {n} of {total, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}
player.errorTitle: Can't play this video right now
player.errorBody: Try a lower quality or reload. You can still download the original.
player.processingNote: Only core members see this. Members will see the video once it's ready. The original is already safe and downloadable.

admin.m_summary: {all, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {admins, plural, one {# admin} other {# admins}}
admin.m_namePh: As they'd like to be shown
admin.m_addHelp: They sign in with a code sent to this email. Admins can also manage the platform.
admin.m_added: {n, plural, one {# member added} other {# members added}}
admin.m_bulkHelp: Separate with commas, spaces or new lines. Each person adds their name and gender when they first sign in.
admin.m_confirmDisableBody: This signs them out on every device and blocks new codes. You can re-enable them later; nothing is deleted.
admin.m_lastAdmin: There has to be at least one admin. Make someone else an admin first.
admin.m_exists: Someone with that email is already a member.
admin.q_videoNote: {n, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} waiting
admin.q_workerStale: The worker hasn't checked in since {time}. Check the cron job.
admin.q_runningForWaiting: Running for {d} · waiting for the processor
admin.q_timesHelp: Times assume one job at a time: SDR video takes about 0.6× its length, HDR about 1.2×. Moving an item to the top shifts every estimate below it.
admin.q_reviewHelp: “Process anyway” uses the default settings. “Keep original only” makes the file downloadable but not playable in the browser.
admin.err_decode_failed: The file is incomplete or damaged, so it can't be decoded.
admin.err_unsupported_codec: The video uses a format we can't convert.
admin.err_timeout: The server ran out of time while converting this item.
admin.err_original_missing: The original file is missing on the server.
admin.err_worker_died: The worker stopped while processing this item.
admin.err_lut_missing: The chosen tone curve isn't installed on the server.
admin.err_spawn_failed: A processing tool couldn't start on the server.
admin.rev_unknown_transferWhy: The video's transfer function isn't SDR, HLG or PQ (for example a Log profile).
admin.rev_hdr_stillWhy: An HDR photo without an SDR base image. v1 doesn't tone map stills.
admin.rev_no_videoWhy: The file has no picture we can read.
admin.i_curveFallback: HDR to SDR · Hable fallback curve, no scores (automatic selection is off).
admin.i_curveOverride: HDR to SDR · curve chosen by an admin.
admin.i_curveAuto: HDR to SDR · chosen automatically: the curve with the best combined quality ranks.
admin.i_curveDisagree: HDR to SDR · the two quality scores disagreed, so the Hable fallback curve was used ({best} ranked best overall).
admin.i_curveFailed: HDR to SDR · scoring didn't finish ({code}), so the Hable fallback curve was used.
admin.i_scoresCaption: Quality ranks for each candidate curve. 1 is best.
admin.i_distsHint: DISTS rank (score in brackets, lower is better): structure and texture compared with the HDR original.
admin.i_topiqHint: TOPIQ rank (score in brackets, higher is better): learned quality compared with the HDR original.
admin.i_reprocessSameHint: Keeps an admin's curve; otherwise the curve is chosen again.
admin.i_confirmBody: Takes about {duration} once the current queue clears, so ready about {time}. The current version stays playable until the new one is ready. The original isn't changed.
admin.i_tierMemberBody: Public: anyone can view and download it, no sign-in needed.
admin.i_tierCoreBody: Core-tier: only core members can see it.
admin.i_confirmTierBody: Access changes right away. Securing the files takes a moment; the item shows “processing” until it's done.
admin.i_girlsOnlyBody: Only female core members and admins can see it.
admin.i_deleteBody: Removes the copies for viewing and the original.
admin.i_confirmDeleteBody: This deletes the original file too ({size}). It can't be undone or re-processed.
admin.i_duplicate: Same file as an earlier upload in this event.
admin.s_noLimit: No size limit on this plan.
admin.s_unknownBody: The host may cap the number of files. Set the limit here once it's confirmed.
admin.s_notMeasured: Not measured yet. The nightly job fills this in.
admin.s_growthNote: Space used at the end of each month
admin.s_curveOff: Off. HDR videos use the verified Hable curve.
admin.c_help: The whole hosting account (every site on it), measured over 1 s and refreshed every 15 s. At these limits the host slows the site down or refuses new processes.
admin.c_unavailable: Live compute is only measured on the server.
admin.s_curveLabel: Choose each HDR video's tone curve automatically
admin.s_curveGatePending: Validation hasn't run yet — selection still works.
admin.s_curveOn: On. Each HDR video's curve is chosen from quality scores.
admin.m_rejectBody: They won't be told. They can send a new request later.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: Before you start, tell us your name and gender. You can change them later on your Account page.
welcome.required: Add your name and choose a gender to continue.
